stem: What can the reader infer about the woman mentioned in paragraphs 4 through 6?

options.label: F
options.text: She is an expert in music in addition to being an expert in dog training.

options.label: G
options.text: She disagrees with the author's choice not to provide his dog with formal training.

options.label: H
options.text: She thinks the author should be more selective about where he brings his dog.

options.label: J
options.text: She is surprised that the author is not interested in learning from her.
